style_framework.aesthetic: Modern warm editorial culinary illustration (gouache / soft cel-shading)
style_framework.framing: Three-quarter 45-degree angle or intimate eye-level close-up, high silhouette contrast
style_framework.human_presence: Forearms and hands only showing active culinary gestures (no faces, no full bodies)
prohibitions: No child-like cartoon or heavy chibi anime style
No functional UI overlays (no digital timers, clock faces, temperature degrees, arrows, badge icons)
No text, watermark, typography, branding or logos
No background room clutter, walls, or kitchen appliance brand logos
